entities.summary: Japanese, a notable figure in the history of Indonesia, associated with Japanese Occupation and Revolution (1942–1945). Preceded by Japanese Occupation and Japanese forces conquer the entire Dutch East Indies within three months. Their legacy influenced Sukarno and Hatta proclaim Indonesian independence and Battle of Surabaya — heroic resistance becomes symbol of the revolution.
